bounded_host_request.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import http.client,json,subprocess,pathlib,unittest,sys
print("ACTION=MEDIA_SAVE_INDEX_FALLBACK_INDEPENDENT_E2E")
try:
 root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
 expected="a003e210d6f5c866118fada3bd356e81d1d92ea0"
 conn=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 conn.request("GET","/healthz")
 response=conn.getresponse();health=json.loads(response.read(16000));status=response.status;conn.close()
 assert status==200 and health.get("commit")==expected,"LIVE_SHA_MISMATCH"
 for method,path in (("GET","/media/jobs"),("POST","/media/save"),("GET","/media/file/"+"0"*32)):
  conn=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
  conn.request(method,path);response=conn.getresponse();code=response.status;response.read(1000);conn.close()
  assert code==401,"OWNER_GUARD_FAILED"
 bin=root/"dist"/"data"/"media-extractors"/"bin"
 for tool,version in (("gallery-dl","1.32.19"),("yt-dlp","2026.10.26")):
  p=bin/tool
  assert p.is_file() and p.stat().st_mode & 0o077==0,"PRIVATE_TOOL_MISSING"
  check=subprocess.run([str(p),"--version"],capture_output=True,timeout=15)
  assert check.returncode==0 and version.encode() in check.stdout,"PINNED_VERSION_MISMATCH"
 js=(root/"app"/"app.js").read_text()
 assert "media[cursor].originalIndex" in js and "media_index:media[cursor].originalIndex" in js,"MEDIA_INDEX_MAPPING_MISSING"
 suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover("tests",pattern="test_*.py")
 with open("/dev/null","w") as out:
  result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=out).run(suite)
 assert result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun>=153,"OFFLINE_TESTS_FAILED"
 print("LIVE_SHA=PASS")
 print("AUTH_GUARDS=PASS")
 print("EXTRACTORS=PASS")
 print("ORIGINAL_INDEX_MAPPING=PASS")
 print("TEST_COUNT="+str(result.testsRun))
 print("PROVIDER_TRAFFIC=NONE")
 print("VERIFY=PASS")
except Exception as exc:
 print("VERIFY=FAIL")
 print("ERROR_TYPE="+type(exc).__name__)
 sys.exit(42)
PY
